'''Jorkatt''', known as '''Jorkatt the Render''', was a [[Nalroni/Legends|Nalroni]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] with base of operations on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Celanon/Legends|Celanon]]. He was known throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] as a despicable and devious felon.
